column1: #mapping_set_description: Correspondences from BRIDGE property IDs (bridge_property:), the values of observed_property, to BERVO, MIxS and METPO terms. First pass 2026-10-07; BRIDGE IDs for every property from 2026-11-03. BERVO release v2026-10-16, MIxS main at 6a2a6edd6.

column7: MIxS depth is the depth of a sample; BERVO Depth is general.
BERVO Nitrate names the substance; this property is its concentration.
MIxS nitrate is the concentration in a sample.
MIxS pH is the pH of a sample; BERVO pH is general.
MIxS temperature is the temperature of a sample.
METPO models this as a data property, not a class.
Candidate match; this property is not limited to soil.
